data.name: HOMUNCULCHU
data.detailed_description:
HOMUNCULCHU is a colony management and survival simulation game where players establish planetary settlements using fragile artificial lifeforms called homunculi.

Your objective is to expand humanity's colonies across six increasingly dangerous planets while managing limited lifespans, disasters, resources, and evacuation decisions.

Each planet acts as a new stage with unique environmental threats, forcing players to adapt their colony strategy in order to survive and progress to the next world.

Assign autonomous homunculi to construction, exploration, resource gathering, and colony maintenance while trying to keep them alive in unstable planetary environments.

Monitor colony activity, react to disasters, issue evacuation orders, and make difficult decisions as unexpected crises threaten your settlements.

Every choice carries risk.

Expand too quickly, and your colony may collapse.

Delay evacuation, and entire populations may be lost.

Humanity can no longer survive on Earth.

PROJECT: SECTOR-LI may be humanity's final attempt at survival.

FEATURES

• Guide autonomous homunculi across six unique planets with distinct environments and hazards.

• Assign work priorities and manage construction, exploration, resource gathering, maintenance, and survival operations.

• Build shelters, facilities, and essential systems to expand planetary settlements.

• React to dynamic disasters including meteor impacts, electromagnetic storms, environmental collapse, and unknown hazards.

• Issue evacuation orders and make critical decisions during colony emergencies.

• Manage limited lifespans, colony resources, and population survival.

• Progress through six increasingly dangerous planets while expanding humanity's final colonies.

• Observe autonomous homunculi live, work, travel, and struggle to survive.

PLANETARY EXPERIMENT

Humanity's final attempt to determine whether life can endure beyond Earth.

Earth's future is uncertain.

Humanity sends homunculi—artificial life—not to save them, but to discover whether survival is still possible.

You are not always in control.

You watch them move on their own.
They build.
They struggle.
They disappear.

Sometimes they survive.

Sometimes they all die.

And when they do, it is because of your decisions.

You cannot save everyone.

You cannot undo every mistake.

You can only decide, observe, and live with the result.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
